sources.title: Janna Build Guide: [26.17] RANK 1 NA JANNA GUIDE — Aery/Glacial

passive.name: Tailwind
passive.text: Janna's allies gain Move Speed moving towards her.Janna deals a portion of bonus Move Speed as bonus magic damage on hit and with Zephyr.

spells.name: Howling Gale
spells.text: By creating a localized change in pressure and temperature, Janna is able to create a small storm that grows in size with time. She can activate the spell again to release the storm. On release this storm will fly towards the direction it was cast in, dealing damage and knocking away any enemies in its path.

spells.name: Zephyr
spells.text: Janna summons an air elemental that passively increases her Move Speed and enables her to pass through units. She may also activate this ability to deal damage and slow an enemy's Move Speed.

spells.name: Eye Of The Storm
spells.text: Janna conjures a defensive gale that shields an ally champion or turret from incoming damage and increases their Attack Damage.

spells.name: Monsoon
spells.text: Janna surrounds herself in a magical storm, throwing enemies back. After the storm has settled, soothing winds heal nearby allies while the ability is active.

damage.value: Janna deals sustained bonus magic damage on hit and bonus magic damage with Zephyr.

archetype.value: Janna is a scaling enchanter who provides crowd control, shields, and playmaking.

axis.value: Janna can poke with Zephyr’s damage and slow rather than commit to an all-in.

winCondition.value: Janna wins through scaling, crowd control, and playmaking.

spikes.why: Janna's healing and shielding increase Glacial Augment's slow.
Janna can increase Glacial Augment's slow further with this item.
Janna increases Glacial Augment’s slow through added heal and shield power.

mistakes.value: Janna gives Howling Gale no time to grow if she releases it immediately.
